rule: issued 00:00 day 1 of quarter t+1 with data published before then; target t+2 (two quarters after the latest predictor quarter t)
note: The target T43 is observed through 2026-Q3 (SWS round posted 2026-10-14, September CPI). At the 2026-10-01 issue date the latest complete target quarter known was 2026-Q2; direct food-insecurity surveys (FIES, subsistence) end in 2023 and are not targets.
